name: rxnaija-sync
description: Sends a pharmacy's stock export to RxNaija on a schedule. Runs on the computer that holds their POS data.
//dependencies: DELIBERATELY NONE. fetch, FormData and Blob are built into Node 18+, so uploading needs no library. A pharmacy PC must never have to run npm install, and a dependency-free program is what makes packaging this into one .exe straightforward later.
//engines: Same 22.12 floor as the server, for one less version to reason about across the two.
